mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript_archives (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, code_session_external_id, from_sequence_num, to_sequence_num, event_count, codec, bucket, object_key, size_bytes, raw_bytes, sha256) VALUES (#{archive.UUID}, #{archive.ExternalID}, #{archive.OrganizationUUID}, #{archive.WorkspaceUUID}, #{archive.CodeSessionUUID}, #{archive.CodeSessionExternalID}, #{archive.FromSequence}, #{archive.ToSequence}, #{archive.EventCount}, #{archive.Codec}, #{archive.Bucket}, #{archive.Key}, #{archive.Size}, #{archive.RawBytes}, #{archive.SHA256,sensitive=true})
mapper.update: UPDATE transcript_archives SET state = 'attached', updated_at = now() WHERE AND uuid = #{archiveUUID} AND state = 'pending' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM transcript_archives WHERE AND from_sequence_num = #{fromSequence} AND state <> 'deleting'
SELECT FROM transcript_archives WHERE AND from_sequence_num > #{after} AND state <> 'deleting' AND state = 'attached' ORDER BY from_sequence_num LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM transcript_archives WHERE AND uuid = #{archiveUUID} AND state = 'attached' FOR SHARE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcript_archives WHERE AND uuid = #{archiveUUID} AND state = 'attached' AND #{sequence} BETWEEN from_sequence_num AND to_sequence_num)
mapper.update: WITH candidates AS (SELECT uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid FROM transcript_archives WHERE state = 'pending' AND updated_at < now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY updated_at, uuid LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE transcript_archives a SET state = 'deleting', updated_at = now() WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates c WHERE c.uuid = a.uuid AND c.organization_uuid = a.organization_uuid AND c.workspace_uuid = a.workspace_uuid) RETURNING
